description.value:
Frequency once per encounter

Requirement You are wielding a two-handed melee weapon and have not yet acted this encounter.

Your first Strike this encounter deals an extra 2d10 damage and the target is pushed 10 feet directly away from you. If that Strike is a critical hit, the target is also knocked prone. Being delayed, readied, or surprised does not preserve this — it is the first swing or it is nothing.
